title: IGRIS Human Approval Submission Schema V1
description: Strict schema for cryptographic intake and verification of human governance reviews across the four designated IGRIS roles.

submission_id.description: Unique identifier for the review intake submission (e.g. SUB-20261117-001).

reviewer_identity.description: Official corporate email or credential identifier of the authorized human reviewer.

role.description: Designated governance role authorized to execute this review.

public_key_id.description: Identifier of the public key registered on the IGRIS governance key registry.

source_ids_reviewed.description: Explicit list of candidate source IDs evaluated in this submission.

decision.description: Formal governance verdict for the evaluated sources.

evidence_references.description: List of cryptographic evidence items audited by the reviewer.

document_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the specific human review markdown document audited by the reviewer.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the human review was completed.

expiry_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp after which this approval lapses and re-certification is mandatory.

digital_signature.description: Cryptographic digital signature computed over the canonical JSON payload.

notes.description: Optional findings, reservations, or conditions stipulated by the reviewer.
